text:
lucy: Heads up - staging publish failed. Regen diff shows generated sample-cli options reordered and a default flip for `authEnabled`.

ci-bot: pipeline 1975.12 failed - regendiff in `sample-cli/src/options.ts`
ci-bot: ```
--- a/sample-cli/src/options.ts
+++ b/sample-cli/src/options.ts
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
- export const defaultOptions = { timeout: 5000, authEnabled: false }
+ export const defaultOptions = { authEnabled: true, timeout: 5000 }
```

sam.engineer: Reproduced locally. The typegen step pulled an accidental `x-sdk-defaults: authEnabled: true` in the OpenAPI spec. Codegen emitted the default and the property order shifted. Some integration tests depend on the stringified options shape.

matt: Semver flag: changing default is a behavioral change. Even if codegen change looks minor, treat as semver-minor at least. We can't sneak this into a patch.

olga: Ok. Quick fixes: revert the OpenAPI metadata edit, add deterministic property sorting in the generator, and add a regen-guard smoke test that checks sample-cli output against a golden.

sam.engineer: I'll open PRs: revert metadata + regen run; generator deterministic sort; and sample-cli smoke test. Also adding a release job check that aborts if regendiff present before stamping.

release-bot: Assigned to @sam.engineer and @olga. Milestone: regen-hotfix-1975.

lucy: Also let's add a changelog policy: any default changes must include a line in sdk/CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased. Don't want downstream surprises.

matt: Agreed. We'll also add a CAUTION note in the typegen contribution guide about x-sdk-defaults.

ci-bot: build started for PR #3550 (revert)

sam.engineer: Revert landed locally fixed tests. Will push PR now. Also filing an issue to make typegen sort properties lexicographically to reduce unrelated diffs.

olga: Thanks. After PRs merge we'll re-run the publish flow. Good catch, folks. :thumbsup:
